CONFIDENTIAL
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. C. I. B. REGISTRY
Section D 2554/9
Date July 16 / 1932

Subject (in full) Communist Meetings held on July 5 and 6.

Made by D.I.Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by [签名]

Some forty "Red" sympathizers, the majority of whom
were male and female workers of various districts in Shanghai,
attended a meeting held in a dwelling house off Route de
Zikawei, French Concession, between 2 and 5 p.m. on July 5.
A representative of the local Chinese Communist Party named
Huang ( 黄 ), who presided over the function, made a report
on the conditions of arrested workers held in gaols and stated
they have insufficient food to eat and do not enjoy freedom
of movement. He emphasized that these workers are struggling
to promote the welfare of the Chinese revolution and condemned
the tyranny of the imperialistic Kuomintang. In conclusion,
he urged the toiling masses to unite in their efforts to over-
throw their opponents - the Kuomintang. The following
demands which were passed by the meeting :-
1) That clothing and food be sent to labourers and students
who are imprisoned for political offences.
2) That efforts be made to interview all political
offenders twice a day.
3) That "Contribution Groups" be organized by various
factories to provide comforts for the Red Army and
arrested workers.
4) That the Police Authorities be requested to increase the
quantity of food allotted to political prisoners who
should also be allowed to wear their own clothing.
------------------
A similar meeting to the above was held in a
Chinese dwelling house off Ferry Road, O.O.L. between 4 and
5 a.m. July 6 and was attended by some twenty persons.
A female communist named Sih Chao Tseng ( 施巧禎 ), who presided,

报告

上海公共租界工部局警务处
档案编号：C. I. B. 登记处
D组 2554/9号
日期：1932年7月16日

事由（全称）：7月5日及6日举行的共产党会议。

制作：督察顾宝华（Kuh Pao-hwa） 转呈：[签名]

约四十名“红色”同情者参加了于7月5日下午2时至5时在法租界徐家汇路（Route de Zikawei）旁一处住宅内举行的会议，其中大多数为上海各区的男女工人。当地中国共产党一名姓黄（黄）的代表主持了该活动，他就监狱中被捕工人的状况作了报告，称他们食物不足，且没有行动自由。他强调，这些工人正为促进中国革命的福祉而斗争，并谴责帝国主义国民党的暴政。最后，他呼吁劳苦大众团结起来，努力推翻他们的对手——国民党。会议通过了以下要求：
1) 向因政治犯罪而被监禁的工人和学生提供衣物和食物。
2) 设法每天两次探视所有政治犯。
3) 由各工厂组织“捐献小组”，为红军和被捕工人提供慰问品。
4) 请求警察当局增加配给政治犯的食物数量，并应允许他们穿着自己的衣物。
------------------
与上述类似的会议于7月6日凌晨4时至5时在越界筑路区（O.O.L.）斐伦路（Ferry Road）旁的一处华人住宅内举行，约有二十人参加。一位名叫施巧禎（Sih Chao Tseng）的女共产党员主持会议，

reported on the recent dismissal of male and female workers
in various factories, the increase of working hours, the
reduction of wages as well as other forms of oppression
by capitalists. She condemned the aggressive measures
adopted by capitalists, Imperialists and the Kuomintang
and urged the labouring masses to unite and declare strikes
in order to secure improved working conditions. The meeting
discussed and passed the following resolutions :-
1) That "Support Groups" and "Vanguards" be organized
against the dismissal of workers without good
cause by Japanese Imperialists.
2) That activities among labouring masses be
extended.
3) That the labouring masses be thoroughly acquainted
with the military operations of the Chinese Red
Army and urged to give every assistance.
Luh Tao-hwa

报告了近期各工厂男女工人被解雇、工作时间延长、工资降低以及资本家的其他压迫形式。她谴责资本家、帝国主义者和国民党采取的侵略性措施，并呼吁劳苦大众团结起来举行罢工，以争取改善工作条件。会议讨论并通过了以下决议：
1) 组织“支援小组”和“先锋队”，反对日本帝国主义者无故解雇工人。
2) 扩大在劳苦大众中的活动。
3) 使劳苦大众充分了解中国红军的军事行动，并号召他们给予一切协助。
陆道华（Luh Tao-hwa）
督察
特别分支负责人。
